snippet.title: Void Tech - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Void Tech is a story-driven space adventure where you step into the role of a satellite technician, tackling critical repairs and navigating contracts from various space agencies and corporations. 

Currently in pre-alpha, we're working hard to bring this world to life. 
Learn more at wecureboredom.com and 
wishlist Void Tech 
on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585900/Void_Tech
